가.note: Vertical vowel ㅏ goes to the RIGHT of ㄱ.

나.note: ㅏ to the right of ㄴ.

고.note: Horizontal vowel ㅗ goes BELOW ㄱ.

구.note: Horizontal vowel ㅜ goes below ㄱ.

다.note: ㅏ to the right of ㄷ.

한.note: ㅎ + ㅏ on top, final ㄴ (batchim) at the BOTTOM.

국.note: ㄱ + ㅜ, then final ㄱ at the bottom.

말.note: ㅁ + ㅏ on top, final ㄹ at the bottom.

사.note: ㅏ to the right of ㅅ.

람.note: ㄹ + ㅏ on top, final ㅁ at the bottom.
